subject: Silver Mine
text: To survive the mine cart ride in the Silver Mine, equip Oil, walk into the cart, attack Spiders while passing through them, and hit the second and third switches.

evidence.quote:
Goal: survive the mine cart ride.
--- Equip Oil and walk into the cart.
--- Attack any Spiders as you pass through them in hopes of avoiding damage.
--- Hit the second and third switches as you pass by them.

subject: Silver Mine
text: Missing switches during the mine cart ride loops the cart back to the beginning.

evidence.quote: If you miss, you'll loop back to the beginning.

subject: Spider
text: Spiders in the Silver Mine can be killed with 1 Fire or 2 Chain hits, but are not worth much experience.

evidence.quote:
Spiders can be killed with 1 Fire or 2 Chain hits.  They are not worth
    much experience.

subject: Flea
text: Fleas are worth a lot of experience and die to 1 Fire.

evidence.quote: Fleas are worth a lot of experience.  Kill with 1 Fire.

subject: Stairs
text: In the Silver Mine, smashing the pot and pressing the button reveals the stairs.

evidence.quote: Smash the pot and press the button to reveal the stairs.

subject: Megapede
text: Megapede follows a set looping path and takes damage when its head is hit with Fire.

evidence.quote:
Megapede follows a set path.
--- It enters from the right, does some loops, then exits to top.
--- Then, it enters from bottom, does some loops, and exits to left.  Repeat....Hit Megapede's head with Fire.

subject: Silver Mine
text: Taking the chest after defeating Megapede exits the cave.

evidence.quote: Take the chest to exit the cave.

subject: Watts
text: Talking to Watts in the Dwarf Village allows buying Silver Armor and the Silver Sword.

evidence.quote:
Talk to Watts and buy the Silver Armor.
- If you had no Ether, purchase the Silver Sword in addition to the Silver
  Armor so you can kill the Crab and Spider enemies easier without MP.

subject: Door
text: The door in Gaia closes when passing through the pillars, and entering the pillars a second time opens them again.

evidence.quote:
The door here will close when you pass through the pillars.  Enter the
  pillars a second time to open them again.

subject: Bogard
text: Bogard shows up upon exiting Gaia.

evidence.quote:
Go Up (Exits Gaia)
* Bogard shows up here.

subject: Crab
text: Crabs south of Gaia die to 2 Silver Sword hits and drop Nectar.

evidence.quote:
The Crabs are nice because they can be killed with the Silver Sword in 2
    hits, and because they drop Nectar.

subject: Cloud
text: Clouds drop Ethers and Wisdom Crystals.

evidence.quote: Clouds drop Ethers and Wisdom Crystals.  Ignore the Pebbler's drops.

subject: Chain
text: Crossing the gap outside the Inn requires a full Will meter for the Chain.

evidence.quote: This gap requires a full Will meter for the Chain to get across.

subject: Owl
text: Owls on the Airship can drop a Crystal when killed with the Chain.

evidence.quote: Kill the Owls with the chain, in case they drop a Crystal.

subject: Eye Spy
text: Eye Spys can be killed in 1 shot by attacking with Fire when the Will bar is partially full.

evidence.quote:
Eye Spys may take 1 or 2 Fires to kill; attack when your Will bar is
    partially full and you'll usually kill them in 1 shot.

subject: Button
text: Pressing the right button allows access to the left button inside the Airship.

evidence.quote: Press the right button to access the left button.

subject: Bogard
text: Bogard leaves the party after talking to the Girl through the fence on the Airship.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the Girl through the Fence.
- Bogard will leave you now.

subject: Basilisk
text: Basilisks in the desert die in a single Fire shot.

evidence.quote: Basilisks die in a single fire shot.  Ignore their treasure.

subject: Medusa Cave
text: At the Oasis, walking up the center between the 2 Palm trees, down the right, up the center, and down the left makes the entrance to Medusa Cave appear.

evidence.quote:
2 Palm trees make 3 lanes (between them, to the right of them, to the left
  of them)
- Walk up the center, then down the right, then up the center, then down the
  left to make the entrance to the cave appear.

subject: Amanda
text: Amanda joins the party upon entering Medusa Cave and can cure Stone status with her ASK command.

evidence.quote:
Amanda just joined you.
--- Amanda can cure the Stone status with her ASK command.

subject: Biting Lizard
text: Biting Lizards in Medusa Cave are invulnerable to Fire.

evidence.quote: Biting Lizards are invulnerable to Fire.  Amanda may kill them.

subject: Mummy
text: Mummies drop Flame, which is barely stronger than Fire.

evidence.quote:
Mummies drop Flame, which is barely stronger than Fire.  Take them if
    you're feeling desperate for MP.

subject: Shadow Zero
text: Shadow Zeroes deal about 50 damage, take 2 hits to kill, grant double experience, and drop Ethers and Wisdom Crystals.

evidence.quote:
Shadow Zeroes deal about 50 damage, so keep your HP completely full!
--- Shadow Zeroes take 2 hits to kill, but grant 2x the experience of
    everything else.
--- Shadow Zeroes drop Ethers and Wisdom Crystals.

subject: Ice
text: After pressing the lower button and escaping with the Chain, open the chest in the next room to obtain the Ice spell.

evidence.quote:
Press the lower button, then use the Chain to escape without sliding onto
  the second button.
- In the next room, open the chest to get Ice.

subject: Spider
text: Freezing a Spider with Ice turns it into a snowman that can be pushed onto the button.

evidence.quote: Use Ice to freeze a Spider, and push the snowman onto the button.

subject: Medusa
text: Fire destroys Medusa's snakes, and her head takes much more damage from Fire than her skirt.

evidence.quote:
Fire will destroy any snakes it passes through.
- Medusa's head takes much more damage from Fire than does her skirt.

subject: Amanda
text: Killing Amanda and walking into her corpse awards the Amanda's Tears item.

evidence.quote:
Kill Amanda, then walk into her corpse.
--- Your inventory must have space for the Amanda's Tears item.

subject: Jadd Shop
text: Gold equipment and the Gold Shield can be purchased from shops in Jadd.

evidence.quote:
Buy Gold equipment.
--- If you are short on money, skip the Gold Shield.

subject: Lester
text: Giving Amanda's Tears to the parrot makes stairs appear, and Lester joins your party.

evidence.quote:
Give Amanda's Tears to the parrot in order to make the stairs appear.
- Lester will join your party.

subject: Black Mage
text: Black Mages in Davias's Mansion are invincible, deal huge damage, and their fireballs can sometimes be blocked by the Gold Shield.

evidence.quote:
Black Mages are invincible, and they deal huge damage.
--- The Gold Shield can sometimes block Black Mages' fireballs.

subject: Stairs
text: Stairs in Davias's Mansion are revealed by pressing the right, up, left, then down button in order.

evidence.quote: Make the stairs appear by pressing the right, up, left, then down button.

subject: Were Axe
text: Heading south in Davias's Mansion allows obtaining the Were Axe by completing an Ice puzzle and defeating Fleas.

evidence.quote:
If you failed to follow the earlier portions of this guide and don't have
  any Nectar, you can head south to get the Were Axe, then return here and
  THEN bust the East wall with a Mattock.  You'll need to complete an Ice
  puzzle and defeat some Fleas.

subject: Davias
text: Against Davias, using Nectar grants +15 attack damage and walking straight into his face while rapidly mashing attack extends invincibility.

evidence.quote:
Use that Nectar, then equip the Cure spell.
--- Nectar grants +15 to your attack damage.  Davias normally takes 5 damage
    from your attacks, so this is x4 damage....Walk straight into Davias's face and mash the A button as fast as you can.
--- Like Hydra, the goal here is to extend your invincibility by continuously
    attacking.

subject: Iffish
text: Iffish encountered on Mt. Rocks are invulnerable to Fire.

evidence.quote: Iffish are invulnerable to fire.

subject: Face
text: Face enemies inside the Metal Crab cave take 2 hits to kill and drop X-Ethers.

evidence.quote:
This room features Face enemies.
--- They will presently take 2 hits to kill, but they drop X-Ethers.

subject: Metal Crab
text: Only Metal Crab's face is vulnerable, which is accessible to full Will bar casts when he is on the top of the arena.

evidence.quote:
Only his face is vulnerable
- His face is not accessible when he's on the bottom of the screen.
--- Therefore, cast with a full Will bar when he is on the top of the arena.

subject: Spring
text: Springs are invincible, move fast and unpredictably, kill in 2 hits, and inflict Moogle status.

evidence.quote:
Springs are invincible, move fast, move unpredictably, kill you in 2 hits,
    and cause Moogle status.

subject: Minotaur
text: Minotaurs die to one cast of Fire.

evidence.quote: Minotaurs die to one Fire.

subject: Button
text: The Werewolf infested puzzle room in Golem's Cave is solved by pushing a chest onto a button and then destroying it.

evidence.quote:
The Werewolf infested puzzle room is solved by pushing a chest onto a button
  and then destroying it.

subject: Cyclops
text: Cyclops's weapon can kill in one hit, and hits to his eye deal more damage than hits to his feet.

evidence.quote: Cyclops's weapon can kill you in one hit....Hits to Cyclops's eye deal more damage than hits to his feet.

subject: Cyclops
text: Defeating Cyclops awards the Morning Star.

evidence.quote: Win the Morning Star.

subject: Golem
text: Fighting Golem by staying close and rapidly mashing the attack button with Morning Star equipped scores 2 hits per swing while prolonging invulnerability.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Morning Star....As before, mash the A button rapidly to prolong invulnerablility.
--- Stay close to the Golem and you'll score 2 hits per swing.

subject: Golem
text: Defeating Golem awards the Lit spell.

evidence.quote: Win the Lit spell.
